implementation: Production offset/double-pitch field Image compared with an ordinary progressive NV12 Image from a separate half-height allocation. CPU materialization independently extracts Y[2*r+parity] into H/2 rows and UV[2*r+parity] into H/4 rows. Identical production Renderer and coordinates intentionally hold sampling constant. Dense Y/UV values vary every row/pair and generation. Shared GBM copy, import and renderer helpers are not independently requalified by this relative comparison.
limits: Layout/render equivalence with independently extracted fields, not absolute JPEG/MPEG2 reconstruction or siting conformance
Common Renderer coordinate behavior is held fixed; previous independent flat-source/luma oracle remains separately scoped
Readback/completion is used; no async retirement/performance/scanout claim
No GStreamer pipeline, source PTS/order, decoder, A/V, live-input or endurance qualification in this standalone comparison
This test is native only; sanitizer NOT_RUN. Strict actual hardware-GL LSan FAIL from nv12-field-20261103.json remains unresolved and is not overridden
No stable release, default promotion or frozen RC2 asset change

negative_control.meaning: Keep correct Y rows and deliberately materialize opposite UV parity. Comparator must detect more than1000 components with error>2. This proves UV-field mismatch sensitivity, not all possible fault detection.
